item.tib: gsang sngags spyi yi lha rgyal tshangs pa dgyes pa'i gad mo
item.coloph: nye gnas kyi dam pa drung yig lha bla tshe dbang rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis thugs sprul ri bo chen po'i mdun zhol stag rtse g.yung drung gling du brtsams pa sarba dzA yan tu/ yi ge pa ni a yu d+hor dzas bgyis pas phyogs dus kun du bde legs su gyur cig/
